memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then God said, "I give you every seed-bearing plant on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They will be yours for food." - Gen 1:29 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Having made human beings and given them their purpose, God now provides for their needs. He points to the plants and trees He has made and says, "They will be yours for food." Before we ever lifted a finger to work the ground, God had already prepared a table for us. Provision came before our labour. Our God is a Provider by nature.

There is such gentleness in this picture. God does not create us and then leave us to fend for ourselves. He thinks ahead, He supplies, He cares for the practical needs of His creatures. The fruit on the trees and the grain in the fields are gifts from His generous hand.

This should quiet our anxious hearts. We so often worry about whether our needs will be met. But the God who filled the earth with food before humanity even needed it is a God who provides. Jesus pointed to this very truth, reminding us that if God feeds the birds and clothes the flowers, He will surely care for us (Mt 6:26-30).

So receive your daily bread as a gift from God. The meal on your table, the provision in your home, it all comes from Him. Give thanks, and trust Him for tomorrow. The Provider who set food on the earth from the beginning has not stopped caring for His children. He knows what you need, and He delights to supply it.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you receive your daily provision as a gift from God's hand, with thankfulness?
2. What worry about provision do you need to entrust to your faithful Provider today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for providing for my needs, often before I even ask. Help me receive Your gifts with gratitude and trust You for all that tomorrow holds. Amen.
